sources.title: GitHub repository metadata
sources.finding: Repository API reports 15094 stars at retrieval; this is popularity context, not a quality score.

sources.title: QM from YC README
sources.locator: Overview, setup, features and component boundaries
sources.finding: Pi is the current core agent loop. Postgres holds durable session state; personal/shared scopes have files, memory, skills, permissions and background work. Operator deploys with own cloud/models/keys.

sources.title: QM from YC license
sources.finding: The cited root license governs this repository distribution, subject to component notices.

sources.title: QM agent swarms
sources.finding: Feature-flagged swarms create durable worker sessions with scoped tokens, model/effort, blank computers, addressed messages, controls and configurable budgets.

sources.title: QM project routes
sources.finding: Authenticated project handlers bind capability identity to actor and expose project creation/membership changes; forbidden mutations are explicit.

sources.title: QM web package
sources.finding: Pinned web client package uses Lit/Vite.

sources.title: QM from YC desktop-v0.1.6
sources.finding: QM Desktop 0.1.6 (GitHub pre-release, 2026-11-06) is a signed/notarized Apple Silicon ZIP with back/forward navigation, Cmd+N and pane-control fixes; existing installs update through the desktop feed.

sources.title: QM from YC plugins/web-ui/README.md
sources.locator: On a phone; Optional analytics; Browser error reporting
sources.finding: Web UI has phone layout and installable PWA. POSTHOG_API_KEY enables browser/core analytics; no key means no analytics requests. SENTRY_BROWSER_DSN enables browser errors and unset disables it; backend DSN never used as browser fallback. Tracing defaults off. PostHog replay follows project settings.

sources.title: QM from YC docs/error-reporting.md
sources.finding: SENTRY_DSN enables backend exception reporting and unset disables it. Error context/stacks are unredacted. Profiling/log/replay disabled by default; optional traces have data scrubbing and sampling. Disable reporting by removing DSN and redeploying.

sources.title: QM from YC docs/swarms.md
sources.locator: Worker goals; Human API; Controls; Defaults
sources.finding: Swarms expose hierarchical worker controls, durable messages/session results and linked worker transcripts. Paused notifications wait; Stop aborts and prevents later worker turns. Goal token caps and optional time/message budgets exist. Provisioning has bounded pools/deadlines and cleanup reconciliation; shared forum outlives worker cleanup.

sources.title: QM from YC docs/mcp-connectors.md
sources.finding: Administrators register HTTP MCP servers; agents cannot change registration. Tools can use shared or per-user encrypted credentials with OAuth/PKCE; calls re-resolve actor credentials and never fall back to another user. Approval is exact-argument one-call, controlled by annotations/all/none.

sources.title: QM from YC docs/files-publication.md
sources.locator: Agent usage; Protocol; Deployment and recovery
sources.finding: Files uploads publish durable S3 bytes/metadata separate from sandbox life. Actor/conversation-bound multipart transfer resumes from durable state, has 100 GiB file/four active-upload limits and 24-hour expiry. Deletion records tombstones. Published artifact remains after sandbox retirement.

sources.title: QM from YC docs/session-sharing.md
sources.finding: Share creates immutable read-only snapshot of visible messages/replies/attachments. Internal audience needs internal sign-in; public bearer link permits downloads. Intermediate reasoning/tools/raw metadata are excluded. No update/revoke control; access disappears if creator loses original access.

sources.title: QM from YC docs/memory-records.md
sources.locator: Capture and curation; Fresh reads; Retained context
sources.finding: Built-in memory has stable record IDs, sensitivity, source scope/session and provenance flags. Revisions are authoritative in Postgres; edits require revision checks, clearing does not erase historical revisions. Access rechecks sources on every read; audience change advances replay cutoff while transcripts/audit remain.

sources.title: QM from YC docs/sandbox-preservation.md
sources.finding: Provider-specific snapshots/pause behavior differs. Modal default one core/2 GiB and 24-hour lifetime; portable tar recovery needs configured S3 bucket. DigitalOcean Managed Agents sandbox template is a microVM with persistent disk across pause/resume. Cold recovery may restore files without processes.

sources.title: QM core-hosted front door
sources.locator: Migration configuration; external OIDC sign-in, paired with web-ui README public SSO front door
sources.finding: Core hosts the public sign-in front door. Optional embedded auth enables email sign-in; omitting it retains external OIDC sign-in configured in env.core. Web UI README describes the portal as the public SSO front door.

sources.title: QM README
sources.finding: Says you run QM in your own cloud with your own models and keys, and the license is MIT. Hosted versions come from third parties (Agent 37, E2B, DigitalOcean), and the README gives no price for them.

sources.title: yc-software/qm LICENSE (MIT)
sources.finding: The MIT License lets anyone obtain, use, copy and modify the software free of charge.

sources.title: QM README (v0.1.17)
sources.locator: README.md lines 6-8 (tagline), 31-37 (Setup) and 46-60 (Features), release v0.1.17 commit 0ceacbc
sources.finding: QM is deployed by the organization in its own cloud with its own models and keys; hosted versions are offered by third parties. Crons, watches and inbound webhooks keep working while the user is away. The README states no QM price or paid plan.
